entry.title: IBM claims 45% productivity gains with Project Bob, its multi-model IDE that orchestrates LLMs with full repository context
entry.summary: For many enterprises, there continue to be barriers to fully adopting and benefiting from agentic AI. IBM is betting the blocker isn't building AI agents but governing them in production.
